sections.heading: Local settings and location search
sections.body: ScootRules stores the language, appearance, confirmation of the disclaimer, and content and legal-text caches locally on the device. After location permission has been granted, the app may use Android system geocoding to turn an approximate location into a country. The app does not retain either the coordinates or the detected country.

sections.heading: GitHub requests and external links
sections.body: Country rules and legal texts are updated via HTTPS from public GitHub sources at most once within 24 hours. GitHub receives the IP address for technical reasons. If you open a source, a reference to another app or a legal text in the browser, the app starts an external application only following your action; its privacy information then applies. In its current functionality, ScootRules does not process children's or health data, photos or files, notifications or cloud backups. There is no user account and no analytics, advertising or tracking services.

sections.heading: Google Play: rating feature
sections.body: After you have viewed three different countries, the app may open the rating feature provided by Google Play at most once every 120 days. Google Play decides whether the dialog actually appears. The app does not transmit any location or usage data. Only the codes of the viewed countries and the time of the last request are stored locally.

sections.heading: Requesting a country by email
sections.body: If you tap “Request a country”, the app opens your email app with a pre-filled message to vardholt@gmail.com (country and app version). It is only sent if you send the email yourself. We then process your email address and the content to answer the request and to plan which countries to add (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR) and delete both once they are no longer needed for this purpose.

sections.heading: Google Play: supporter purchase
sections.body: Via “Support ScootRules” you can voluntarily make a one-time in-app purchase through Google Play Billing. Google handles payment and processing and processes your payment and account data under its own privacy policy. We do not receive any payment data. The app only asks Google Play whether the purchase exists and stores this status locally on the device. All content remains free to use without a purchase.

sections.heading: Fetching and updating the legal texts
sections.body: To keep the legal notice and privacy policy current, the app fetches the JSON versions only from raw.githubusercontent.com at most once every 24 hours and stores them locally. This technically transmits your IP address to GitHub. Without an internet connection, the versions bundled with the app are shown. If you select “Open in browser”, the matching HTML version is opened through GitHub Pages in an external application. The fetch is based on our legitimate interest in keeping mandatory information current (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: Under the GDPR you have, in particular, the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection, as well as the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. App data is generally stored locally under your control, so you can inspect, change or delete it there. Where external providers process data after you voluntarily open links, their privacy information applies.

sections.heading: Changes to this policy
sections.body: This privacy policy is updated when the app, the services used or the data processing changes. The current version is available in the app and at the linked address.
